item.title: Roommate Wanted
item.description: Looking for Queer-Friendly Roommate Rent: $450/month + utilities (about $50/month) Location: Urbana, IL (5 min from campus) Available: September 1st About the Space Cozy 2-bedroom house with hardwood floors, updated kitchen, and a fantastic back porch perfect for morning coffee. About Me Hey! I’m Charles (they/them), 26, a grad student at UIUC. I love cooking, board games, and hanging out wiht my two cats, Mr. Whiskers and Luna! What I’m Looking For Clean but not obsessive Okay with cats House Rules Overnight guests welcome (just communicate!
